t: A hackable ESP32-S3 smartwatch with LoRa, GPS, NFC, and an AMOLED touchscreen.
steps: Buy the watch from the LILYGO store or LILYGO on Tindie. Pick the LoRa band legal in your country.
Charge it over USB-C with a normal phone charger.
For messaging, flash the Meshtastic firmware with the Meshtastic web flasher.
Install the Meshtastic phone app and pair it over Bluetooth.
For your own code, install the Arduino IDE with Arduino-ESP32 3.3.0-alpha1 or newer.
Add the LilyGoLib and LilyGoLib-ThirdParty libraries.
Upload the LilyGoLib factory example to see every part working.
Learn to enter download mode by hand. Early builds sometimes drop the USB link.
